primary_rule: Maximize the minimum sampled expected ranking payout across models passing both full-catalog CDF checks; lexicographically smallest allocation breaks exact ties. Population models are not given posterior weights.
secondary_rules: Union of original 87 and newly qualified models
Qualified models excluding all equal-centered catalogs
scope: Independent finite-catalog regeneration and fitting, two independent score-CDF checks covering the full stored incumbent law, full search over all 4598126 legal allocations, and fresh fixed-candidate confirmation. Numerical replication does not identify actual applicant allocations.
